summary: The council gives {person} authority to declare an emergency while the river is still in its banks.
realLife: King County council members voted unanimously to let Executive Kurt Triplett act ahead of Green River flooding.
gates: The council can authorize an emergency measure while flooding is still forecast.
weights: Long procurement lead times favor granting authority in advance.
inGame: needs: the limits of a county emergency authorization.

turns.what: The council reserves the decision until the river rises.
turns.pulledBy: The vote to grant advance authority falls short.
turns.writesBack: The minutes leave the ordinary declaration process in effect.

turns.what: The council authorizes advance purchases up to a limit.
turns.pulledBy: Members approve supplies and withhold broader contracting authority.
turns.writesBack: The ordinance records the spending ceiling.
